prompt: Vertical 9:16 close snapshot on grainy consumer colour film, flash off, inside a cramped British corner shop at night. A low metal shelf of plain white sliced bread in clear plastic bags, most of the row gone: one loaf left at the end, a gap where the others were, crumbs on the shelf. A white shelf-edge label in sharp focus reads "£1". Above it a fluorescent tube flickers, caught half-bright, throwing a cold green-blue cast. The aisle behind falls off into soft blur and shadow, deeper than it should be. Off-centre, slightly underexposed, lifted murky blacks, visible grain. Unbranded packets, no people. Not polished, not CGI. Thanks.
